title: hemionitis pygmaea
intro: Hemionitis pygmaea, commonly known as Dwarf Hemionitis, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae, a type of small, terrestrial fern. It has been traditionally used in Asian medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis pygmaea include wound healing, anti-aging, and protection against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
